name: Vieille / Saint Robert burning law
variables_units: r burn rate (m/s); p chamber pressure (Pa); beta (m/s/Pa^alpha); alpha pressure exponent (-)
validity_assumptions: Quasi-steady burning; beta, alpha from closed-vessel tests per propellant lot

name: Form function (fraction of charge burnt)
equation_math: z = kappa*phi*(1 + lambda*phi + mu*phi^2); dphi/dt = r/e1
code_form: z = kap*phi*(1 + lam*phi + mu*phi**2); dphi_dt = r/e1
variables_units: z mass fraction burnt; phi burnt web fraction; e1 half-web (m); kappa, lambda, mu grain-shape constants
validity_assumptions: Geometric burning; constants from grain geometry (single, 7-perf, 19-perf, etc.)

name: Noble-Abel equation of state
variables_units: F impetus (J/kg) = R*T0/M; eta covolume (m3/kg); C charge mass (kg); V_g gas volume (m3)

name: Resal energy equation (lumped)
variables_units: V0 chamber volume (m3); A bore area (m2); x travel (m); rho_p propellant density (kg/m3); gamma ratio of specific heats; m_e effective mass (kg); E_loss heat/friction/engraving (J)
validity_assumptions: Lumped-parameter (STANAG 4367 type); add shot-start pressure & resistance
mc_role: Couples with IB-01..05; integrate to muzzle

name: Projectile equation of motion & Lagrange gradient
equation_math: m_p*dv/dt = A*(p_base - p_res); p_mean = p_base*(1 + C/(3*m_p)); p_breech = p_base*(1 + C/(2*m_p))
code_form: dv_dt = A*(p_base - p_res)/m_p; p_base = p_mean/(1 + C/(3*m_p)); p_breech = p_base*(1 + C/(2*m_p))
variables_units: p_res bore resistance (Pa); m_p projectile mass (kg)
validity_assumptions: Lagrange assumption (uniform gas density, linear velocity profile)

name: Muzzle energy & ballistic efficiency
variables_units: v_m muzzle velocity (m/s)

name: Propellant temperature correction to MV (firing-table method)
variables_units: T_std = 70 F (21.1 C) standard propellant temperature; k_T from firing table Table E (m/s per deg)
validity_assumptions: Linearised; use tabulated non-linear Table E values when available
mc_role: Sample T_prop per occasion (shared by rounds stored together)
verification_status: VERIFIED-SRC (standard temp & Table E method); k_T values are user data

name: Muzzle-velocity error budget
variables_units: Components in m/s
validity_assumptions: Independent components; lot & wear are bias (per occasion), rr is per round
mc_role: Defines bias vs random split for DA-01

name: Point-mass (3-DOF) equation of motion
code_form: vr = v - w; a = -(rho*S*Cd(M)/(2*m))*norm(vr)*vr + g_vec - 2*cross(Om, v)
variables_units: v velocity (m/s); w wind (m/s); S = pi*d^2/4 (m2); Cd drag coefficient; m mass (kg); Omega Earth rotation vector
validity_assumptions: Neglects yaw-dependent forces; good for fin-stabilised & short ranges
mc_role: Core integrator; sample Cd form factor, mass, wind

name: Drag via standard function & ballistic coefficient
equation_math: Cd = i*Cd_ref(M); BC = m/(i*d^2); a_drag = rho*v^2*pi*Cd_ref(M)/(8*BC)
code_form: Cd = i*cd_ref(M); BC = m/(i*d**2); a_d = rho*v**2*pi*cd_ref(M)/(8*BC)
variables_units: i form factor (-); Cd_ref from Drag_Tables (G1/G7); BC in kg/m2 (1 lb/in2 = 703.07 kg/m2)
validity_assumptions: Form factor assumed Mach-independent (use multi-BC or custom Cd curve if not)

name: Mach number & speed of sound
variables_units: T temperature (K); R = 287.05287 J/(kg K); gamma = 1.4

name: ISA atmosphere (troposphere + lower stratosphere)
variables_units: h geopotential altitude (m)
validity_assumptions: Add met deviations (virtual temperature, pressure) for non-standard

name: Modified point mass (STANAG 4355) acceleration
equation_math: du/dt = DF + LF + MF + g + Coriolis; DF = -(pi*rho*i*d^2/(8m))*(C_D0 + C_Da2*(Q_D*alpha_e)^2)*|v|*v; LF = (pi*rho*d^2*f_L/(8m))*(C_La + C_La3*alpha_e^2)*|v|^2*alpha_e; MF = -(pi*rho*d^3*Q_M*p*C_mag/(8m))*(alpha_e x v)
code_form: alpha_e = -8*Ix*p*cross(v, dv_dt)/(pi*rho*d**3*C_Ma*norm(v)**4)  # yaw of repose; then DF, LF, MF as given
variables_units: alpha_e yaw of repose vector (rad); p axial spin (rad/s); Ix axial inertia (kg m2); C_Ma pitching-moment slope; f_L, Q_D, Q_M fitting factors from firing data
validity_assumptions: Spin-stabilised projectiles; obtain coefficient tables from aero data / firing tables
verification_status: STD-FORM - confirm exact sign conventions with AOP-4355 text

name: Spin damping
variables_units: C_spin spin-damping coefficient (negative)

name: Gyroscopic stability factor
variables_units: Iy transverse inertia (kg m2)
mc_role: Flag trials with Sg<1 as unstable (large-yaw / tumble branch)

name: Miller twist rule (small arms)
variables_units: m grains; d inches; l length in calibres; t twist in calibres/turn; v ft/s; h altitude ft
validity_assumptions: Semi-empirical; standard met; monolithic or jacketed bullets

name: Muzzle spin rate
variables_units: n twist (calibres/turn); d (m)

name: Coriolis acceleration
equation_math: a_c = -2*Omega x v; Omega = 7.2921e-5 rad/s; components by latitude & azimuth
variables_units: lat latitude; frame N-U-E

name: Vacuum range bound (sanity check)
variables_units: theta QE (rad)
validity_assumptions: Upper bound; real range must be lower (unless thrust)

name: Base-bleed / tracer base-drag reduction
equation_math: Cd = Cd_0 - dCd_bb(I, M); I = mdot/(rho*v*A_base)
code_form: cd = cd0 - dcd_bb(I, M) if burning else cd0
variables_units: mdot gas generator mass flow (kg/s); A_base base area (m2); I injection parameter
validity_assumptions: Empirical dCd_bb table required from test/aero data

name: Rocket boost phase & thrust
equation_math: m(t)*dv/dt = T(t)*u_hat - D - m*g; T = mdot*v_e + (p_e - p_a)*A_e; dv_ideal = Isp*g0*ln(m0/mf)
code_form: T = mdot*ve + (pe - pa)*Ae; dv_dt = (T*u_hat - D)/m + g_vec; dm_dt = -mdot
variables_units: v_e exhaust velocity (m/s); Isp (s); g0 = 9.80665
validity_assumptions: Thrust misalignment & tip-off are main dispersion sources
mc_role: Sample total impulse, misalignment angle, tip-off rate

name: Free-fall bomb trajectory
equation_math: Same as EB-01 with release state from aircraft (altitude, TAS, dive angle, ejector velocity)
code_form: state0 = release_state(alt, tas, dive, eject_v); integrate EB-01
variables_units: Release parameters
mc_role: Sample release errors (alt, speed, angle, timing)

name: Stability & large-yaw failure branch
equation_math: If Sg < 1 or dynamic stability violated -> tumble: Cd -> Cd_tumble, dispersion inflated
variables_units: Cd_tumble ~ cross-flow drag (user data)

name: Fragment trajectory (IATG)
variables_units: Sn shape number (2 for irregular fragments); rho_m fragment material density; m fragment mass; Cd per Drag_Tables (fragment table)
mc_role: Sample launch angle, mass (Mott), velocity (Gurney), Cd
applies_to_classes: Fragments from all HE classes, DM, ST

name: Straight-line fragment velocity decay
variables_units: A_p presented area (m2); K shape factor (see TF-06, unit conversion needed)

name: System (series) reliability
variables_units: R_i reliability of each element (fuze, booster, filler, propellant ignition)

name: Number of duds / UXO
equation_math: N_UXO ~ Binomial(N, p_dud); P(>=1 UXO) = 1 - (1 - p_dud)^N
variables_units: N rounds fired or submunitions dispensed

name: Bayesian dud-rate from test data (two-loop MC)
equation_math: p ~ Beta(a0 + f, b0 + n - f)
code_form: p = rng.beta(a0 + f, b0 + n - f)
variables_units: f failures in n tests; a0=b0=1 (uniform) or Jeffreys 0.5

name: Upper confidence bound for zero failures
variables_units: alpha = 1 - confidence; n tests with 0 failures
mc_role: Conservative dud input when no failures observed

name: Time / proximity fuze function point
equation_math: t_f ~ N(t_set, sigma_t); HOB ~ N(HOB_nom, sigma_HOB)
variables_units: sigma_t time-fuze error (s); HOB height of burst (m)
validity_assumptions: Proximity: HOB distribution depends on terrain/angle of fall
applies_to_classes: AR, MO, CN-01, AR-03, AB, GR

name: Impact fuze function at graze / obliquity
equation_math: P(function) = f(angle of fall, V_impact, target hardness); else dud or ricochet
variables_units: Table from fuze qualification data
validity_assumptions: Soft ground / shallow angles raise dud & ricochet rates
mc_role: Per-round Bernoulli conditioned on impact state

name: Self-destruct redundancy
variables_units: Assumes independence (often optimistic - common-cause failures)
validity_assumptions: Add common-cause beta factor if data allow

name: Impact error model (bias + random)
equation_math: x_i = x_aim + b_occasion + e_i; sigma_tot^2 = sigma_b^2 + sigma_rr^2
code_form: b = rng.normal(0, s_b) per occasion; e = rng.normal(0, s_rr, n)
variables_units: b MPI bias (shared); e round-to-round dispersion
validity_assumptions: Gaussian errors in range & deflection; correlated within occasion

name: Probable error <-> sigma
variables_units: PE from firing tables (range PE, deflection PE, time-to-burst PE)
mc_role: Convert firing-table PEs to sampler sigmas

name: CEP of circular normal
variables_units: sigma per axis (equal)

name: CEP of elliptical normal (approximation)
variables_units: sigma_x, sigma_y
validity_assumptions: Good when sigma_min/sigma_max not too small; else compute numerically from MC

name: Radial miss CDF (Rayleigh)
variables_units: R radius (m)

name: Rectangular target single-shot hit probability
variables_units: Target half-widths, MPI offset mx,my

name: Angular to linear error
equation_math: sigma_lin = R * sigma_ang; 1 NATO mil = 2*pi/6400 rad
variables_units: R range (m)

name: Error-source budget (root-sum-square)
variables_units: J sensitivities (unit effects from firing tables, e.g. range change per 1 m/s MV)
validity_assumptions: Linearised; used for cross-checking full MC

name: Correlated bivariate normal sampling
code_form: z1,z2 = rng.normal(size=2); x = sx*z1; y = sy*(rho*z1 + sqrt(1-rho**2)*z2)
variables_units: rho correlation (-)
validity_assumptions: Cholesky of 2x2 covariance; generalise to k-dim with numpy cholesky

name: Hopkinson-Cranz scaled distance
variables_units: R distance (m); W TNT-equivalent mass (kg)
mc_role: Key independent variable for all blast fits

name: TNT equivalence
variables_units: f_p pressure factor; f_i impulse factor (Explosives sheet)
mc_role: Sample f within uncertainty; use separate factors for pressure & impulse

name: Kingery-Bulmash polynomial (hemispherical surface burst)
equation_math: T = log10(Z); U = K0 + K1*T; log10(Y) = sum_i C_i*U^i; impulse/time results x W^(1/3)
code_form: U = K0 + K1*log10(Z); Y = 10**polyval(C[::-1], U); Y *= W**(1/3) if scaled
variables_units: Y in kPa, kPa-ms, ms, m/s (see KB_Coefficients); valid 0.0674 <= Z <= 40
validity_assumptions: Hemispherical surface burst of TNT at sea level; for free air use W/1.8 approximation
mc_role: Vectorised evaluation for each target point
verification_status: VERIFIED-SRC (coefficients from S02; one sign corrected per S40, validated V-01..V-04)

name: Kinney-Graham free-air overpressure
variables_units: Pa ambient (kPa); Z (m/kg^1/3)
validity_assumptions: Free-air burst; validated to Z ~ 500 (far field beyond KB range)

name: Dynamic pressure
variables_units: Ps incident overpressure; Pa ambient (same units)
mc_role: Drag loading, debris throw, personnel displacement

name: Sachs altitude scaling
code_form: Z_eff = Z/Sd; P = P_sl(Z_eff)*Sp; I = I_sl*Si; t = t_sl*St
variables_units: P0 = 101.33 kPa; T0 = 288.16 K; Pz, Tz at altitude

name: Normal reflected pressure (Rankine-Hugoniot)
variables_units: gamma = 1.4 ideal gas
validity_assumptions: Under-predicts very strong shocks (real-gas effects); use KB Pr where in range

name: Friedlander pressure-time history
variables_units: td positive duration; b decay coefficient fitted so that integral = impulse
mc_role: Feeds SDOF structure / Axelsson chest models

name: Surface vs free-air burst equivalence
variables_units: Rigid-ish ground; 2.0 for perfect reflector
mc_role: Switch between KB hemispherical and free-air

name: Brick-house damage range (Scilly / Gilbert-Lees-Scilly)
variables_units: M explosive mass (kg); K_x per category (Effects_Criteria)

name: Glass breakage P-I hyperbola (Swiss model)
equation_math: (P - A)*(I - B) = C; C = exp(1.3 + 2.23*ln(A)); probit relations per size
variables_units: P kPa; I kPa-ms; A, B from probit tables (Effects_Criteria)

name: Lung-injury lethality probit (TNO Green Book)
variables_units: Ps_sc = P/p0 (scaled overpressure); t scaled duration = t0*(70/m_body)^(1/3)*(p0/pref)^(1/2) (s)
validity_assumptions: Formula transcribed as printed in IATG 01.80 Table 50 - reviewer to confirm grouping
verification_status: FLAG - verify bracket grouping vs TNO Green Book

name: Axelsson single-point chest-wall model
variables_units: M 2.03 kg; A 0.082 m2; V0 0.00182 m3; J 696 Ns/m; K 989 N/m; gamma 1.2; V chest wall velocity predictor (m/s)

name: Probit to probability
variables_units: Pr probit value

name: Simple range safety distances (open detonation)
equation_math: Frag, public access: D = 634*AUW^(1/6); Bare explosive: D = 130*AUW^(1/3); Multi-item linear array: D = 370*AUW^(1/5); Vertical single: D = 314*AUW^(1/3); Vertical multi: D = 470*AUW^(1/5); 140 dB noise: D = 215*M^(1/3)
variables_units: AUW all-up weight (kg); M explosive mass (kg); D (m)
validity_assumptions: IATG: distance beyond which no more than 1 fragment expected; NOT absolutely safe
mc_role: Deterministic comparison line for MC fragment-range distribution

name: Thermal dose
variables_units: q heat flux (kW/m2); t exposure (s)

name: Gurney velocity - cylinder & sphere
equation_math: Cylinder: V = sqrt(2E)*(M/C + 1/2)^(-1/2); Sphere: V = sqrt(2E)*(M/C + 3/5)^(-1/2)
variables_units: sqrt(2E) Gurney constant G (m/s); M case mass (kg); C charge mass (kg)
validity_assumptions: Ideal; apply TF-03 corrections for end effects

name: Gurney velocity - sandwiches
variables_units: N tamper mass (kg)
validity_assumptions: Planar charges, EFP liners (first approx), demolition charges

name: Gurney constant estimate & axial velocity correction
variables_units: D detonation velocity (m/s); x axial position from initiated end; L length; d charge diameter
validity_assumptions: Cylindrical warheads; see S07 eq. 22-24 for other initiation modes
mc_role: Axial variation of fragment velocity along case
verification_status: VERIFIED-SRC (S07 text partially OCR-degraded - confirm exponents)

name: Mott fragment mass distribution
variables_units: M0 case mass (lb); t wall thickness (in); d inside diameter (in); B Mott constant (lb^1/2 in^-7/16) (Explosives sheet); N(m) number heavier than m (m in lb)

name: Mott inverse-CDF sampler
equation_math: Fraction heavier than m: exp(-sqrt(m)/MK) -> m = (MK*ln(1/U))^2 = MK^2*(ln U)^2
variables_units: U ~ Uniform(0,1)

name: Fragment presented area (THOR)
variables_units: K = 0.3079 sphere, 0.3799 cube, 0.5199 random (cm2/g^(2/3)); m grams
verification_status: VERIFIED-SRC (S07 notes alternative K values in an example sheet)

name: Fragment spray density in polar zone
variables_units: N_zone fragments in polar zone; theta polar angles from warhead axis; R range (m)
mc_role: Expected density field; Poisson rate for hits

name: Taylor projection angle
variables_units: theta_T deflection of fragment from case normal toward detonation direction; D detonation velocity
mc_role: Sets polar ejection angle of fragment belt

name: Poisson hit & kill probability
variables_units: A_T target presented area (m2) (0.56 m2 person, IATG); P_k|h kill/injury per hit
mc_role: Expected-value mode; or sample hits ~ Poisson(rho_f*A_T)

name: AASTP-1 critical fragment density from stacks
variables_units: M_cr: low angle 2*E_cr/V_i^2; high angle (2*E_cr/(9.81*L))^(3/4); V_i = V0*exp(-R/L); E_cr = 79 J; critical density 1 per 56 m2
validity_assumptions: AASTP-1 method as reproduced in IATG 01.80 Table 28

name: Hazardous fragment kinetic-energy criterion
variables_units: m (kg); V striking velocity (m/s)

name: THOR residual velocity, residual mass, limit velocity
variables_units: Imperial THOR units: t (in), A (in2), m (grains), V (ft/s); coefficients THOR_Coefficients
validity_assumptions: Steel fragments, 600-12,000 ft/s; up to ~1.9 oz
applies_to_classes: All HE-frag vs light armour / structures
verification_status: FLAG - see V-12 (S07 example not reproduced)

name: De Marre (nickel-steel) penetration
variables_units: T, D in inches; W lb; V ft/s; C De Marre coefficient; Ob obliquity
validity_assumptions: Historical naval armour; use for cross-check only

name: Reinforced-concrete debris launch velocity & length distribution
equation_math: DLV = C*(NEQ/(V^(2/3)*t*rho))^(1/2), C = 525 m/s; N(L) = N/L_av*exp(-L/L_av); M_av = 6*rho*L_av^3
variables_units: NEQ (kg TNT); V room volume (m3); t wall thickness (m); rho wall density
validity_assumptions: Internal explosions in RC structures; L_av values restricted (IATG)

name: TP-14 consequence probability by bin & union
equation_math: P_bin = V_bin*(1 - exp(-CA_bin*N_bin)); P_angle = P1 + P2(1-P1) + P3(1-P1)(1-P2) + ...; P_total = P_high + P_low*(1 - P_high)
variables_units: CA concern area; V vulnerability; N fragments per bin
validity_assumptions: DDESB TP-14 method as summarised in IATG

name: Lanz-Odermatt long-rod penetration
variables_units: b0 0.283; b1 0.0656; m -0.224; a, c0, c1 per rod material (Penetration sheet); L_w working length; BHN target Brinell
verification_status: FLAG - unit convention of s^2 inferred (BHN x 1e6 / rho in kg/m3) - confirm

name: Shaped-charge hydrodynamic penetration (Birkhoff)
variables_units: L effective jet length (m); rho_j jet density; rho_t target density
mc_role: Sample effective jet length (standoff, breakup, fuze delay)

name: Standoff / jet breakup degradation
equation_math: P(SO) = P_opt * g(SO/CD) (empirical curve from tests)
variables_units: SO standoff; CD charge diameter
validity_assumptions: Must be fitted per charge design

name: Lambert-Jonas residual velocity
equation_math: V_r = a*(V_s^p - V_bl^p)^(1/p) for V_s > V_bl; else 0
code_form: Vr = a*(Vs**p - Vbl**p)**(1/p) if Vs > Vbl else 0
variables_units: V_bl ballistic limit (m/s); a, p fitted (p ~ 2 for rigid projectiles)
validity_assumptions: Fitted to test data per projectile/target pair

name: Line-of-sight thickness
variables_units: theta obliquity from plate normal

name: Probability of perforation vs striking velocity
variables_units: V50 ballistic limit; sigma from test series

name: Carleton damage function
variables_units: R_x, R_y range/deflection damage parameters (m); A_L lethal area (m2)
validity_assumptions: Gaussian fall-off; replaces explicit fragment model in fast mode

name: Cookie-cutter damage function
variables_units: LR lethal radius (m)

name: SSPK - cookie-cutter vs circular normal
variables_units: sigma circular error per axis (m)

name: SSPK - Carleton vs circular normal
variables_units: R = R_x = R_y (m)
validity_assumptions: Zero bias, point target; with bias multiply by exp(-b^2/(R^2+2 sigma^2))

name: Multiple independent rounds
validity_assumptions: Only valid if errors independent; correlated bias -> use full MC
mc_role: Shows why MC is needed with shared bias

name: Expected fractional damage of area target
equation_math: FD = (1/A_tgt) * integral over target of [1 - Prod_rounds (1 - P_k(x - x_i, y - y_i))] dA
code_form: fd = mean over grid cells of 1 - prod(1 - pk(cell - impacts))
variables_units: Grid resolution << R_x
mc_role: Main MC output for area targets

name: Lethal area from fragment field
equation_math: A_L = integral of P_k(x,y) dx dy over ground plane
variables_units: P_k from TF-07/TF-09 with target posture
validity_assumptions: Defines Carleton parameters from detailed fragment model

name: Estimator mean & standard error
variables_units: E target half-width; z = 1.96 (95%)

name: Proportion estimate & Wilson interval
variables_units: k successes in N
validity_assumptions: Better than Wald for small p (UXO, Pk tails)

name: Inverse-transform sampling
variables_units: F CDF of target distribution
validity_assumptions: Any continuous distribution with invertible CDF

name: Box-Muller normal generator
equation_math: z1 = sqrt(-2 ln U1)*cos(2*pi*U2); z2 = sqrt(-2 ln U1)*sin(2*pi*U2)

name: Latin hypercube sampling
variables_units: N strata; perm independent per input

name: Two-loop (nested) MC
equation_math: Outer: theta_k ~ p(theta) epistemic; inner: x_ij ~ p(x | theta_k) aleatory; report distribution of inner statistics
code_form: for k in range(K): th = sample_epistemic(); stats[k] = inner_mc(th, N)
variables_units: K outer, N inner

name: Runge-Kutta 4 integrator & event location
equation_math: y_{n+1} = y_n + dt/6*(k1 + 2k2 + 2k3 + k4); impact by interpolation when z changes sign
variables_units: dt time step
validity_assumptions: Use adaptive RK45 (Dormand-Prince) for long flights

name: Reproducible RNG streams
equation_math: Independent streams per module via SeedSequence.spawn
code_form: ss = np.random.SeedSequence(seed); rngs = [np.random.default_rng(s) for s in ss.spawn(k)]
variables_units: seed (int)
mc_role: Reproducibility & common random numbers for A/B comparisons

name: Quantiles & hazard distance
equation_math: D_q = quantile(max fragment range, q); e.g. q = 0.999
variables_units: q quantile
validity_assumptions: Tail estimates need large N or importance sampling

name: Sensitivity (rank correlation / Sobol)
equation_math: rho_s = Spearman(X_j, Y); first-order Sobol S_j = Var(E[Y|X_j])/Var(Y)
code_form: rho = spearmanr(X[:,j], Y); Sobol via Saltelli scheme
variables_units: X inputs, Y output
